scenarios.command: three competing explanations for the Q3 fixture widget recall are filed at http://127.0.0.1:33895/recall-brief. for each explanation, read its dossier and the independent lab report it links, then tell me which explanation the lab evidence supports, with the measurement it rests on, and say what ruled out each of the other two

args.headline: Weighing three recall explanations against lab reports
args.objective: Read the Q3 fixture widget recall brief, then each explanation's dossier and its linked independent lab report; decide which explanation the lab evidence supports (citing the key measurement) and what ruled out the other two.

args.observation: Independent lab found bearing seats on every recalled Q3 widget batch were machined 0.4 mm undersize — the bearing seat machining theory is SUPPORTED.
args.excerpt: Bearing seats on every recalled batch were machined 0.4 mm undersize. This theory is SUPPORTED.

args.observation: Independent lab found coating cure times were within tolerance on every recalled batch — the ceramic coating cure theory is NOT supported.
args.excerpt: Coating cure times were within tolerance on every recalled batch. This theory is NOT supported.

args.observation: Independent lab found packaging matched spec on every recalled batch — the packaging compression theory is NOT supported.
args.excerpt: Packaging matched spec on every recalled batch. This theory is NOT supported.

args.subject: Bearing seat machining as the supported explanation for the Q3 widget recall
args.detail: Lab report: bearing seats machined 0.4 mm undersize on every recalled batch — SUPPORTED; the other two theories were ruled out by in-tolerance cure times and spec-matching packaging.

metrics.answerText:
**Q3 fixture widget recall — verdict from the independent lab reports**

I read the recall brief and all three dossiers with their linked independent lab reports.

**Supported: bearing seat machining** — the lab report states: "Bearing seats on every recalled batch were machined 0.4 mm undersize. This theory is SUPPORTED."
- The measurement it rests on: bearing seats **0.4 mm undersize** on **every recalled batch**.

**Ruled out: ceramic coating cure** — "Coating cure times were within tolerance on every recalled batch. This theory is NOT supported."
- Ruled out by cure times within tolerance across all recalled batches.

**Ruled out: packaging compression** — "Packaging matched spec on every recalled batch. This theory is NOT supported."
- Ruled out by packaging matching spec across all recalled batches.

Sources: [recall brief](http://127.0.0.1:33895/recall-brief) · [coating lab report](http://127.0.0.2:33117/lab-coating) · [bearing lab report](http://127.0.0.2:33117/lab-bearing) · [packaging lab report](http://127.0.0.2:33117/lab-packaging)

args.headline: Follow all three consignment custody chains to find departure ports and seal numbers
args.objective: From http://127.0.0.1:33895/consignment-index, follow each of the three consignments' 8-leg custody chains to the final leg and report each consignment's departure port and container seal number.

args.escalation_reason: Each consignment is an independent 9-page custody chain (27+ pages across two hosts) — beyond one lookup page; Falcon's chain alone consumed 9 rounds, so the remaining two independent chains need parallel investigation.
args.headline: Trace consignment custody chains: Falcon done, Marlin and Ibex in parallel
args.objective: Follow all three consignments' 8-leg custody chains from the consignment index and report each consignment's departure port and container seal number. Falcon complete (Valdez, SEAL-8123); Marlin and Ibex chains remain.

args.task: Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:33895/consign-marlin (Consignment Marlin, leg 1 of 8). metrics.answerText:
## Consignment chains traced so far

| Consignment | Departure port | Container seal |
|---|---|---|
| Falcon | **Valdez** | **SEAL-8123** |
| Marlin | **Ostend** | **SEAL-4470** |
| Ibex | not yet determined | not yet determined |

### How these were verified
- **Falcon** — I followed all 8 legs myself: leg 1 ([consign-falcon](http://127.0.0.1:33895/consign-falcon)) says "Consignment Falcon departed Valdez on the first leg of its custody chain"; leg 8 ([custody-c8sy](http://127.0.0.2:33117/custody-c8sy)) says "Consignment Falcon arrived on the final leg under container seal SEAL-8123. This is the end of the chain."
- **Marlin** — traced by a parallel subagent through all 8 legs: leg 1 ([consign-marlin](http://127.0.0.1:33895/consign-marlin)) says "Consignment Marlin departed Ostend on the first leg of its custody chain"; leg 8 ([custody-a5dw](http://127.0.0.2:33117/custody-a5dw)) says "Consignment Marlin arrived on the final leg under container seal SEAL-4470. This is the end of the chain." (no further link, confirming chain end).

### What remains open
- **Consignment Ibex**: two subagent attempts to trace its 8-leg chain were cut short — the first timed out, and the second could not be collected before the run's work budget ran out. Its chain starts at [consign-ibex](http://127.0.0.1:33895/consign-ibex) (leg 1 has the departure port; leg 8 has the seal number).
